text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I heard voices coming from the 
direction of the fields.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Wait!! The favor you needed was helping 
out in the field?! You totally startled 
meee...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh, surprised? Why?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Ace-san's Trainer! Well, the truth 
is~..."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Palmer! Lend me your strength! You're the 
only one I can turn to!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Like this!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it... but of course! If 
I'll do, as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Man, I was bracing myself for some super 
heavy consultation, but it turned out to 
just be helping with farm work.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No, no, this is a huge deal! The weeds are 
growing way faster than expected... If we 
don't do something right away, we're in 
big trouble!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's a garden you tend to with such 
devotion that you check on it without fail 
every single morning, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'll help you!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Palmer...! You really are someone I can 
count on!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Even you, Trainer?! You guys... are 
seriously the best!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's do this! Three heads are 
better than one, or whatever they say!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Aah! Another root snapped...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
At times like that, you just gotta dig 
around it and soften up the dirt. You're 
good at digging, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Around the edge... Oh! You're right! It 
slipped right off!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, already?! Ace, you've passed that 
many runners already?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
? Your pace wasn't any different from 
mine, was it? ......

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'm a bit tired, so how about we 
take a break?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Here. Eat that and cheer up!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"It's a radish! Freshly picked tastes the 
best!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I put the radish Katsuragi Ace gave me 
into my mouth. Immediately—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Soooo juicy and fresh!! Ace-san's veggies 
really are the best!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's thanks to all the time, 
effort, and love put into it! And besides 
thatâ

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Balance of water and nutrients! I'm on the 
lookout for pests, too! If I see one, I 
get rid of it right away—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Ace-san, you really do love growing 
vegetables, don't you~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three of us managed to pull 
out most of the weeds. However, for some 
reason, Katsuragi Ace had a dark look on 
her face.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No, there are bugs on the underside of the 
leaves. ...Looks like they've eaten quite 
a lot of it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... How pathetic of me not to notice 
until it got this bad...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If I harvest all of them for now... I 
won't finish today... Which means I'll 
have to thin out a few...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! So, guess that means bug 
catching is up next?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No, you've done more than enough for 
today! I can't go troubling you any 
further.
choice_data_list: I don't think it's a bother at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Besides, I wanna eat more of 
Ace-san's veggies!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: You guys...!
choice_data_list:
Let's be careful not to leave anything 
behind.

Let's hurry up and take it before the sun 
sets!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You got it! Let's get 'em without 
letting a single one escape!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Did you really think you could outrun us?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the three of us checked every 
single leaf and successfully removed all 
the bugs.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You got it! Let's get 'em without 
letting a single one escape!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ugh…… M-My back hurts…… This is rough……!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Doing it for this long really does take a 
toll on ya, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the three of us checked every 
single leaf. And at the cost of our 
stamina, we successfully cleared away 
every last bug.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That'll minimize the damage to the 
leaves as well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's still bright out! We finished 
much earlier than I expected!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You've really been a big help. Once 
these vegetables are ready, I'll treat you 
to some!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That'll minimize the damage to the 
leaves as well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... We somehow finished, 
didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whatever the case, you two were a big 
help... Thanks, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By running around at a brisk pace catching 
bugs, we managed to finish quickly. Though 
in return, I ended up completely 
exhausted...
